data.name: Spellblade Parry
data.description: When an enemy makes a melee attack roll against you, as an immediate action you can end the athame's duration to gain a deflection bonus to your Armor Class until the end of your next turn. This bonus is equal to the level of the spell sacrificed to create the athame (maximum +5).
